UserQuota.title: UserQuota
UserQuota.description: Tracks daily action consumption (AI lookups, AI bonding summaries, and chemical file imports) per authenticated Google user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this quota record.

dateKey.description: Current UTC calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

actionCount.description: Number of quota-governed actions used on dateKey (0 to 25).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the quota record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the quota record was last updated.

/userQuotas/{userId}.description: Per-user daily usage quota document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
